ios.desc:
Eatelligence is your AI-powered kitchen companion that helps you manage your pantry, discover recipes, and plan meals
   effortlessly.

  SMART PANTRY MANAGEMENT
  • Scan barcodes to instantly add items to your pantry
  • Take photos of groceries and let AI identify them
  • Track what's in stock and what's running low
  • Filter items by store to see where you shop
  • View estimated nutrition totals for your pantry

  AI RECIPE SUGGESTIONS
  • Tap "What can I make?" and get personalized recipes based on what you actually have
  • Recipes respect your dietary preferences and allergies
  • Save your favorites for quick access later

  INTELLIGENT MEAL PLANNING (Pro)
  • Generate weekly meal plans tailored to your pantry and goals
  • Plans adapt to your diet: keto, vegetarian, high-protein, and more
  • Save meal plans and access them anytime

  SMART GROCERY LIST
  • Simple, clean grocery list that syncs across devices
  • AI suggests what to buy based on your pantry, diet, and goals (Pro)
  • One-tap to add suggested items

  PERSONALIZED TO YOU
  • Set your dietary preferences: vegetarian, vegan, keto, gluten-free, and more
  • Add allergies and ingredients to avoid
  • Choose your goal: lose weight, build muscle, eat healthier

  Download Eatelligence and transform the way you cook, shop, and eat.

  Terms of Use: https://eatelligence-policy.vercel.app/terms
  Privacy Policy: https://eatelligence-policy.vercel.app/privacy

quotes.text:
I built a mobile app that scans barcodes or photos of food in your pantry and uses GPT-4 to suggest recipes based on what you actually have.

Tech stack: React Native (Expo), Supabase for backend/auth,
react-native-vision-camera for scanning, OpenAI API for recipe generation.

Built it in about a week.It's free to use with a premium tier. iOS only for now.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/eatelligence/id6755645485

Would love feedback or questions!
